Watch As Fresh Pumpkin Is Cooked, Blended, And Carefully Dried Until It Turns Into A Soft, Chewy, Naturally Sweet Treat. This Is Old-World Cooking At Its Best — Healthy, Honest, And Perfect For Anyone Seeking Natural Homemade Snacks.
